method: Full clips sampled every 15 seconds; IMG_0765 hardware windows sampled every 3 seconds and IMG_0767 handling at 5 seconds. Still-based action windows are accurate to approximately 2–3 seconds, not frame-accurate cuts.

findings.title: ENTTEC USB-B socket and USB plug
findings.notes: Shows the square USB-B socket on the ENTTEC and the cable plug side by side, then plugging. Useful technical insert.

findings.title: 3-pin / 5-pin adapter ends
findings.notes: Both round connector ends held toward camera. Adapter attachment continues at 155–160 seconds if needed.

findings.title: Moving-head rear connections
findings.notes: Whole light lifted toward camera; rear DMX IN/OUT and mains input panel visible. Excellent port establishing shot.

findings.title: Three-pin male/female DMX cable ends
findings.notes: Male and female ends held side by side, then mated. This is a cable join, not a terminator.

findings.title: Assembled rig running
findings.notes: Five fixtures and laptop visible; moving heads and LED bar lit. Useful result coverage, not a close-up.
